sn51.2:1.1: yesaṃ kesañci bhikkhave cattāro iddhipādā viraddhā viraddho tesaṃ ariyo maggo sammādukkhakkhayagāmī.
sn51.2:1.2: yesaṃ kesañci bhikkhave cattāro iddhipādā āraddhā āraddho tesaṃ ariyo maggo sammādukkhakkhayagāmī.
sn51.2:1.4: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu chandasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti.
sn51.2:1.8: yesaṃ kesañci bhikkhave ime cattāro iddhipādā viraddhā viraddho tesaṃ ariyo maggo sammādukkhakkhayagāmī.
sn51.2:1.9: yesaṃ kesañci bhikkhave ime cattāro iddhipādā āraddhā āraddho tesaṃ ariyo maggo sammādukkhakkhayagāmīti.
